summary: the noentropy suite, whose steps require the random devices and getrandom to refuse while the generator is untrusted, with three faults in the kernel; a failing run is followed by one of every step, make told to go on past a failure

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

RACH2_ARCH=${ARCH:-i686}
REPO=$(pwd)
. ./mk/arch.sh
status=0
sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run noentropy || status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo 'noentropy-proof: every step, with make told to go on past a failure'
    rm -f "$ARCH_BUILD/images/noentropy-rng.log" "$ARCH_BUILD/images/noentropy-keygen.log"
    make -i run-noentropy "ARCH=$RACH2_ARCH" "RACH2_QEMU=$ARCH_QEMU" </dev/null 2>&1
    cat "$ARCH_BUILD/images/noentropy-rng.log" "$ARCH_BUILD/images/noentropy-keygen.log" 2>/dev/null
fi
exit "$status"

faults.summary: the random devices answer a read while the generator is untrusted, which also lets dropbearkey make a key
